name: 2000 S. Prairie Avenue — the alley building of the house at 2000 (district draft; refined by T-1937)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads '2-storey brick stable (crossed) on the alley at the 20th Street end'. Drawn as a stable in 1911, so its 1904 use needs no backcast; the envelope is the 1911 one.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2351, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1937 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35 trace (s35fp-2000-b5), the T-1842 census (s35-2000-rear) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35-059; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-20-22-west-2351).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1842 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 0.500, v 17.750 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: 3BB frame on a deep lawn at the 20th Street corner (the register's 'painted clapboard, timber sash/eaves and porch'): three storeys under the default low hip, its wings and porches as the sheet traces them; its door is on the north, toward the corner, and 2010, the twin in plan the sheet attests, mirrors it. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2371618059 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
